items.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Wardell was the one who wrote the tune, yeah.

ctx.x: And the tenor player — refresh my memory, was it Wardell Gray?
Wardell was the one who wrote the tune, yeah.

items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got Wardell’s wife a little part... Wardell Gray’s wife Jeri, who was known as Jeru, gave me the recipe for meatloaf

ctx.x: In Short Cuts you actually got to play a vocalist, called Tess Trainer. Can you talk about that one? Was that a more suited role for you?

I certainly knew what it was about. I got Wardell’s wife a little part. I told her to come on the set. I introduced her to Bob, and he gave her lines, which entitled her to become a member of whatever it is.
